# Reviewed exceptions to the "no local-machine paths" check.
#
# Each entry is `path:reason`. An exception is only acceptable when the string
# is documentation text or a platform-guarded fallback, never when the pipeline
# reads or writes that path on a runner. Adding a line here is a review
# decision, which is the point: the rule stays strict and the exceptions stay
# visible.

scripts/export_publication_snapshot.R:Windows rerun instructions embedded in the generated snapshot README; not a path this script opens.
scripts/render_phenotype_report.R:Pandoc discovery falls back to the Windows default only when ProgramFiles is set, which never happens on a Linux runner.
